rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low-rise courtyard slab with one dominant gesture: a compact perimeter mass wrapped around a central void, plus a clear access response along the blue frontage through the carved/open edge. It is visible in all views and the silhouette stays continuous rather than collapsing into disconnected pieces. The top view confirms parcel response and a meaningful open-space figure instead of simple box-filling. For neighborhood living, the mass plausibly supports active ground edge + upper hierarchy, although the section remains somewhat generic and could be strengthened with a more explicit profiled or stepped public roof/terrace logic. Overall it is program-fit and related to the provided neighborhood/community references, especially in the courtyard/bridge and carved-void principles.
